title: Explicit Recovery Action Required for Terminally-Failed Courses
description: The agent module shall return a terminally-failed course to eligibility only via an explicit recovery action.
rationale: A bare manual database status reset without resetting the attempt counter and backoff timestamp leaves stale state that causes immediate re-exhaustion on the next run; only the designated recovery action atomically resets all lifecycle fields to a clean state, so it is the sole supported path. Resolves OQ-1: bare manual status reset is disallowed.
